decisions.reason: The hyaluronic acid facial serum fits our established skincare formulation, sourcing, and customer-advice knowledge very closely, so we can absorb market feedback and improve it with relatively low risk.

The facial cleansing milk remains close to our existing product and production base, and with another year of learning we can adjust formula and positioning without stretching the firm's capabilities.

The facial cleansing oil is also strongly related to our core know-how, but as the newest launch it still carries higher uncertainty until we have a full cycle of sales and user feedback to assimilate.
